census.note: REBUILT from the frozen authored inputs and asserted byte-identical to the programs recorded in raw (0 program-hash mismatches over all 1,584 cases); counts are PER RUN and there are two identical runs.

_meta.n_unmeasured_MEANS: the number of COMPILER-SELECTED OPERAND CLASSES OR CONTEXTS this generated recipe does NOT cover.  It is deliberately NOT a field-label count: RE_EXPERIMENT_PROCESS_CORRECTIONS section 2 says `emittable` requires a complete generated recipe and that FIELD LABELS ALONE ARE NOT AN EMITTABILITY PROOF, and Gate D says a canonical recipe must cover the classes the compiler will actually select.  Each entry is enumerated in `coverage_gaps`.
_meta.question: can a complete falu2 and a complete device_store be constructed byte by byte from documented rules, across the operand classes a compiler actually selects, and their COMPLETE observable state predicted in advance -- with zero fields taken from a compiler-emitted donor
_meta.scope: EXP-0220 wrote records ONLY for the three mnemonics it generated and gated itself.  It does not touch any other mnemonic's record, and it changes no label anywhere.
_meta.supersedes_note: EXP-0173's template_dependency.json scored these mnemonics from EXP-0167's corpus, where device_load/device_store/falu2 appear both in the rule-driven generator AND in twelve hand-copied CF programs.  EXP-0220 does not retract that measurement of THAT corpus; it reports a DIFFERENT corpus -- 3,168 programs in which every field of every instruction is rule-derived -- which is what the recipe question actually asks.
_meta.target: G17P (Apple A18 Pro), direct.  Nothing ran on the M4.

coverage_gaps: srcB_class = 1 with index 0..63 -- the UNIFORM-REGISTER operand source.  8 cases were dispatched and are recorded, but this carrier does not seed the uniform file, so they are not predicted.  NOT counted as a blocker: every value a uniform could supply is reachable through a GPR or the inline immediate, both proven here, so an implementer can generate any falu2 without it -- but it stays OPEN on the capability map.

instructions.why: 620 gated cases over 13 arms, EVERY ONE matching a host prediction of the COMPLETE state (24 architectural registers plus every byte of all three bound buffers), in two clean runs whose full 32 KiB output digests are identical case for case.  Every field was driven across its full encodable domain except `ctrl` (the 2-bit instruction-length selector is held at the 6-byte form), `srcB_imm` (the packed-immediate overload is a different descriptor) and `srcA_class` (class 1 reads 0.0 at every index).  Operand classes covered: GPR, inline 8-bit float immediate (all 64 codes x 2 signs x 2 ops), and the two constant-zero classes; operand PROVENANCE covered: live device_load result, ALU result and mov_imm, at instruction distances 0/1/2.  Zero fields COPIED, zero CARRIER.

coverage_gaps: THREADGROUP address space (`space` bit1).  Four values dispatched; all four FAULT against a device-bound buffer.  An implementer cannot emit a threadgroup store from this recipe.  THIS IS THE ONE GAP THAT KEEPS THE VERDICT AT generated-no-donor.
extmode >= 128 (a data-register index >= 64): 62 values dispatched and recorded; whether the 7-bit index reaches r64..r95 or aliases mod 64 as EXP-0112 found for a falu2 SOURCE is not resolved here.

seven index_reg values (96,97,100,111,112,120,127) FAULT, reproducibly in both runs.  This CONFIRMS EXP-0141 on G17P, but the frozen contract mislabelled their predicted bucket `exact`, so they are the experiment's 7 Gate-C misses.

space, index_reg, st_format, elem_size, access_desc, reserved7, reserved13, st_format_ext and st_desc_hi were SAMPLED (10, 37, 8, 7, 8, 5, 5, 6 and 7 values respectively), not swept densely as section 3 asks for a w <= 8 field.

instructions.why: 819 gated cases over 10 arms, every one matching a complete-state host prediction in two clean runs -- including the full 256-value `addr_mode` sweep in BOTH data-source classes (512 cases) and all six documented `st_format` shapes.  `base_slot` is HARDWARE-PROBED here (arm S0) instead of being read off a compiled instruction, so the copied-region ledger is empty.  NOT canonical: the THREADGROUP address space is a class a compiler routinely selects and this recipe does not cover it -- the four `space` bit1 values FAULTED against a device buffer and no threadgroup carrier was built.

instructions.why: device_load is not an arm of EXP-0220, but it is a rule-generated component of almost every program here: 18,130 assemble calls across 3,168 executed programs, ZERO fields COPIED and ZERO CARRIER, with `base_slot` hardware-probed rather than read off a compiled instruction.  Its destination register (extmode) took 156 distinct values and its immediate offset 240, each verified against a complete-state host prediction.  EXP-0173 scored this mnemonic `generated-point` because EXP-0167's twelve hand-copied CF programs also contain it; that measurement of THAT corpus stands, and this is a different corpus in which no field is copied.  Four fields (addr_mode, access_desc, reserved7, reserved13) still lack an emitter-grade label, so the recipe is not canonical.
